title: Tensor Recovery with Heterogeneous Mode Structures
abstract: arXiv:2611.30435v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tensor recovery methods often impose a common structural assumption across modes, even when different modes may exhibit distinct forms of regularity. We propose a unified convex framework that treats each mode according to its structure. Smoothly varying modes form an indexing domain and are handled by local kernel weighting, whereas retained modes may receive low-rank, group-sparse, graph-Laplacian, or autoregressive regularization in distinct and potentially overlapping combinations. The framework also covers ordinary tensor recovery without local smoothing. A consensus HM-ADMM algorithm separates the active penalties into tractable proximal and linear-system updates. For the population-quadratic estimator, we derive deterministic oracle inequalities and high-probability bounds under independent trace regression. translated_title: 具有异质模式结构的张量恢复
translated_abstract: 张量恢复方法通常对各模式施加统一的结构假设，即使不同模式可能表现出不同形式的正则性。我们提出了一个统一的凸优化框架，根据各模式自身的结构对其进行区别处理：平滑变化的模式构成一个索引域，通过局部核加权加以处理；而保留的模式则可以接受低秩、组稀疏、图拉普拉斯或自回归正则化，这些正则化可以以不同且可能相互重叠的组合方式施加。该框架也涵盖了不带局部平滑的普通张量恢复。我们提出一种共识式 HM-ADMM 算法，将激活的惩罚项分解为易于处理的近端更新和线性系统更新。对于总体二次估计量，我们在独立迹回归假设下推导出确定性的 oracle 不等式和高概率误差界。这些界将随机误差、秩与支撑集复杂度、平滑偏差以及二次失配分离开来，并且还识别了……
tldr: 提出了一个针对异质模式结构的统一凸张量恢复框架，对平滑模式采用局部核加权、对其他模式分别施加低秩、组稀疏、图拉普拉斯或自回归正则化，配合共识式 HM-ADMM 算法求解，并给出了 oracle 不等式与高概率误差界的理论保证。
en_tdlr: A unified convex tensor recovery framework that treats each mode according to its own structure—applying local kernel weighting to smoothly varying modes while allowing low-rank, group-sparse, graph-Laplacian, or autoregressive regularization for others—solved by a consensus HM-ADMM algorithm and backed by deterministic oracle inequalities and high-probability error bounds.
